name: Spinal Cord Infarction
definition: Acute ischemic injury of the spinal cord causing sudden motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction.

redFlags.item: Rapid respiratory compromise in high lesions

investigations.principle: MRI spine with diffusion-sensitive sequences and vascular/cause-directed evaluation are central.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Structural compression must be excluded urgently.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pakshaghata/Vata-type descriptors may be documented only after modern vascular diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Acute ischemic injury of the spinal cord causing sudden motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.

sources.title: Spinal cord ischemia and stroke resources
